spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (शब्दयति)
To sound, to make or utter sound;
with the prefixes प्र, प्रति, or वि, as well as uncompounded, this root means also:
1 To promise.
2 To make clear or manifest, to explain.
3 To speak.

m. (-ब्दः)
1 Sound in general.
2 A sound, a word.
4 (In grammar,) A declinable word, as noun, pronoun, &c.
E.
शब्द to sound, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दी-ब्दं)
1 Sonorous, sounding.
2 Nominal, (as inflection.)
f. (-ब्दी)
SARASVATĪ, goddess of speech and eloquence.
E.
शब्द sound or a word, and अण् attributive aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Making sound, sounding, sonorous.
E.
शब्द sound, &c. कृ to make, अण् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 The ear.
2 Receiving or catching sound.
3 A fabulous arrow.
E.
शब्द sound, ग्रह what receives.

m. (-रः)
A plagiary.
E.
शब्द, and चोर a thief.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sounding, sonorous.
(-नं)
Sounding, uttering sounds.
E.
शब्द to sound, aff. युच्.

n. (-ह्म)
Inspired writ, the Vedas as uncreated and identifiable with the supreme spirit.
E.
शब्द, and ब्रह्मन् the supreme.

m. (-दी)
1 A name of ARUṆ

The anus.
E.
शब्द sound, noise, and भेदिन् breaking.

f. (-निः)
A root, a radical word.
E.
शब्द, and योनि place of origin.

m. (-धी)
ARJUNA.
E.
शब्द sound, and वेधिन् piercing; terrifying his enemies by his shouts.

f. (-क्तिः)
Force or signification of words.
E.
शब्द, and शक्ति power.

n. (-नं)
The rules of grammar.
E.
शब्द, and शासन regulating.

n. (-स्त्रं)
Philology, grammar, &c.
E.
शब्द, and शास्त्र a science, &c.

m. (-हः)
A vocabulary, a lexicon.
E.
शब्द, and संग्रह collection.

m. (-दिः)
The objects of sense, as sound, form, scent, juice, contact; or what affords matter for the exercise of hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting and touching.
E.
शब्द, and आदि other.

n. (-नं)
The ear.
E.
शब्द sound, अधिष्ठान receptacle.

n. (-पं)
1 Conformity or proportion to the sound.
2 Imitation of sound.
E.
शब्द, and अनुरूप conformity.

n. (-नं)
The acceptation or sense of words.
E.
शब्द, and अनुशासन government.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sounding.
E.
शब्द sound, nominal verb, शानच् aff.

m. (-र्थः)
1 The sense or meaning of words.
2 Words and sense.
E.
शब्द, and अर्थं sense.

m. (-रः)
Rhetorical use of words; verbal figure, as alliteration, &c.
E.
शब्द, and अलङ्कार ornament.

Sounded.
2

Uttered, articulated.
3 Explained, made public or manifest.
4 Converted into a noun, &c. शब्द to sound, क्त aff.; or शब्द, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to sounds or words.
m. (-कः)
A proficient in the senses and forms of nouns or words.
E.
शब्द a sound, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A man with his wife.
E.
स with, बधू a wife, and कन् added.

m. (-लिः)
Evening twilight.
E.
स for सह with, बलि offering of food to evil spirits; the proper hour for such ceremonies.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Painful, hurtful.
2 Oppressive, extortionary.
E.
स with, बाधा pain.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Studying together, being disciples of one teacher.
E.
स with, ब्रह्मचर्य्य studentship.

m. (-री)
A fellow student, one engaged in the same studies and observing the same austerities.
E.
स for सह with, and ब्रह्मचारिन् the religious student.

f. (-ब्दी)
A sort of grape.
